basic_details.scholarship_name: American University of Beirut (AUB) Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program
basic_details.offering_entity: American University of Beirut (AUB) & Mastercard Foundation
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: American University of Beirut (AUB, Bliss Street, Beirut, Lebanon)
degree_levels: Master of Science (MS / ME / MPH / MEM)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Master's programs across Maroun Semaan Faculty of Engineering and Architecture, Faculty of Arts and Sciences, Faculty of Health Sciences, and Faculty of Agricultural and Food Sciences: Computer Science, Engineering Management, Public Health, Environmental Sciences, Rural Community Development, Applied Energy, and Data Analytics.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~30 to 45 fully funded Mastercard Foundation Scholarships awarded per cohort across master's degrees
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Competitive international quota; typically 3 to 6 Pakistani scholars selected per annual cohort
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 24 months (2-year full-time master's degree) plus preparatory summer term if required

nationality_requirements: Citizens and residents of economically disadvantaged backgrounds from Lebanon, refugee communities, and international developing nations including Pakistan
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Preference given to young applicants aged 35 or younger at time of application.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Recognized 4-year Bachelor's degree (16-year BS / BSc / BE) from an HEC-recognized university with high academic distinction (minimum CGPA 3.40 / 4.00 or 78%+ equivalent to AUB grade 80/100).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum CGPA 3.40 / 4.00; selected scholars typically possess CGPA >= 3.65 / 4.00.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Undergraduate degree in computer science, engineering, biological sciences, public health, or environmental studies with demonstrated alignment to community development.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or enrolled in final undergraduate year graduating prior to August intake.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: Bachelor's degree completed within preceding 5 years.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Community leadership, volunteering, grassroots social projects, or NGO involvement is heavily evaluated alongside academic merit.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 6.5, TOEFL iBT minimum 80, or AUB English Entrance Exam (EEE). MOI certificates not accepted for scholarship shortlisting.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: All academic instruction and research at AUB are 100% in English.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Open equally to male and female applicants; strong commitment to gender parity and inclusion.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Demonstrated financial disadvantage combined with academic merit and leadership potential; commitment to give back to home community.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold another full external scholarship concurrently.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition fees waived for all coursework and thesis credits at AUB (worth ~$28,000 to $36,000 total).

admission_application_fee.details: AUB graduate application fee ($50) waived or refunded for eligible Mastercard Foundation applicants.

accommodation.details: Fully furnished on-campus dormitory accommodation at AUB student halls or dedicated off-campus residence.

monthly_stipend.details: USD 800 / month tax-free living allowance disbursed in fresh US Dollars (~PKR 225,000 / month) for 24 months.

airfare.details: Round-trip economy international airfare between Pakistan and Beirut Rafic Hariri International Airport at the start and end of the program.

visa_fee.details: Lebanese student entry visa, residency permits, and official governmental processing fees covered directly by AUB.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive health insurance covering hospitalization, outpatient, and emergency care at American University of Beirut Medical Center (AUBMC).

food_allowance.details: Covered via monthly USD 800 living stipend plus campus dining card / meal plan credits.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Brand new high-performance laptop provided upon arrival, plus semester academic textbook and materials allowance.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Comprehensive funding for master's thesis research, community development capstone projects, and annual Mastercard Foundation Scholars convening travel.
research_funding_conference_grant.amount: Full thesis research grant & convening travel

travel_transit_allowance.details: Airport reception and airport transfer in Beirut, plus local transport support.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single host university (American University of Beirut - AUB, Beirut, Lebanon).
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: #1 or #2 in the Arab Region (QS Arab University Rankings); top 250 globally (QS World University Rankings); chartered by the State of New York; Middle States accredited.
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: HEC-recognized Bachelor's degree (CGPA >= 3.40/4.00), IELTS 6.5+ or TOEFL 80+, demonstrated socio-economic financial need, proven community leadership track record, and completed MCF online application.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Apply simultaneously through the AUB Graduate Admissions portal and the dedicated AUB Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program application portal before the March 15 deadline.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Center your application narrative on transformative leadership and socio-economic transformation in Pakistan. Highlight practical grassroots projects, empathy, and how you will tackle poverty, public health challenges, or climate resilience.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: AUB Mastercard Foundation Online Scholarship & Admissions Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Step 1: Register on the AUB Graduate Admissions portal and the MCF Scholars application system. Step 2: Fill out the comprehensive financial need assessment and family socioeconomic questionnaire. Step 3: Upload transcripts, degree certificates, CV, English scorecards, and leadership essays before March 15.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Review eligible master's degree programs and MCF selection criteria on aub.edu.lb/mcf.
Step 2: Submit an online application for graduate admission to AUB.
Step 3: Complete the dedicated Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program application questionnaire.
Step 4: Complete the detailed household income, financial need, and asset disclosure section.
Step 5: Write and upload leadership and give-back essays detailing community impact in Pakistan.
Step 6: Register two referees (one academic and one community/civic leadership referee).
Step 7: Submit the complete dossier before the deadline (March 15).
Step 8: MCF Selection Committee conducts administrative screening and financial background verification.
Step 9: Shortlisted candidates invited for personal panel interviews (online) in May.
Step 10: Final scholarship awards announced in June; visa, flights, and dormitory arrangements arranged by AUB.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Dual Routing: Applicants must submit both an AUB Graduate Admissions application and the dedicated Mastercard Foundation scholarship questionnaire.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by referees via confidential portal upload link; one must address academic competence and one must address community leadership.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Detailed essay prompts covering: (1) Family socio-economic background and financial challenges overcome, (2) Evidence of leadership and social impact in the community, (3) Vision for giving back to Pakistan after graduation.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: A 2-page outline of intended master's research or community capstone intervention.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Detailed academic and leadership CV highlighting volunteer initiatives, extracurriculars, honors, and technical proficiencies.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Intensive 30-45 minute online panel interview with AUB professors and Mastercard Foundation representatives probing leadership ethics, resilience, and vision.
application_process_roadmap.application_fee_amount: $0 (Application fee is waived for MCF applicants)
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: HEC and MoFA document attestations from Pakistan; final legalization for Lebanese authorities upon selection.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translation for all official records.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online submission via AUB MCF Scholars portal.

required_documents_checklist.specification: HEC-attested undergraduate degree in relevant discipline with minimum CGPA 3.40 / 4.00.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested by HEC and MoFA Pakistan.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete transcripts of all undergraduate semesters showing course grades and credit hours.
Comprehensive essays explaining community leadership achievements and commitment to return to Pakistan.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Detail actionable social transformation plans in Pakistan.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Documentation verifying financial background: household income proof, salary slips, bank statements, and utility bills.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Authentic salary certificates or affidavit of household income.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Detailed CV emphasizing community activism, social leadership, volunteer initiatives, and academic honors.
One academic recommendation from university professor and one community leadership recommendation.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: On official institutional letterhead with verified contact details.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official IELTS (min 6.5) or TOEFL iBT (min 80) test certificate.
Clear scan of passport biographical data page valid for at least 2 years.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: MCF Scholars Program operates on an annual cycle opening in November with strict deadline on March 15.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 30% (Undergraduate transcript excellence, degree honors, and academic capability)
selection_process_and_weights.extracurricular_and_leadership_weight: 30% (Demonstrated leadership track record, community activism, and empathy)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 10% (Technical background, capstone project, and research aptitude)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 15% (Quality of leadership essays and commitment to give back to Pakistan)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: 5% (Panel interview performance evaluating values, resilience, and vision)
selection_process_and_weights.financial_need_weight: 0% (Qualifying prerequisite: candidate must demonstrate genuine financial disadvantage)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: AUB Mastercard Foundation Steering Committee, Faculty Deans, and Program Directors.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Holistic evaluation matrix balancing academic merit, transformative leadership potential, and verified socio-economic financial need.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~3,000 to 5,000 applicants across the region and international pool
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~30 to 45 fully funded scholarships per cohort
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~1.5% to 2.5% among eligible applicants meeting financial need criteria
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: 3.70 / 4.00 accompanied by documented grassroots community leadership
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates with stellar academic records who have founded student initiatives, volunteered in flood relief / disaster response, established educational programs, or worked with underprivileged communities in Pakistan.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates from LUMS (National Outreach Programme), IBA Karachi (Talent Hunt Program), NUST, UET Lahore, and regional public universities across Pakistan.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Lebanon, Palestine, Syria, Pakistan, Yemen, Sudan, Kenya, Ghana.

fake_websites_and_scams: Only apply through official AUB portal https://www.aub.edu.lb/mcf/.
Mastercard Foundation and AUB never charge any fee for application, testing, or processing at any stage.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Application to the Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at AUB is 100% free; do not pay any application fee.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Commercial agency written essays will lead to immediate disqualification; MCF conducts extensive verification of personal essays and socio-economic declarations.
hidden_costs_breakdown: IELTS / TOEFL test fees in Pakistan: ~PKR 60,000 (can sometimes be waived or subsidized by MCF upon request).
HEC and MoFA document attestations in Pakistan: ~PKR 15,000 - 25,000.
All international flights, visa costs, tuition, housing, laptop, and monthly stipends are 100% COVERED by Mastercard Foundation.
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: Wealthy students can win if they have top grades. Reality: Financial need is an absolute prerequisite; applicants undergo thorough asset and income verification.
Myth: You cannot study computer science under MCF. Reality: STEM and computing fields like Computer Science and Engineering Management are high-priority funded tracks.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial sites claim Lebanese residency is required; the MCF program at AUB is explicitly open to international scholars from developing nations including Pakistan.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.20 / 4.00 (80/100) throughout the master's program.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time study attendance; mandatory active participation in MCF leadership retreats, mentorship sessions, and community service projects.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Term-by-term academic progress and community engagement monitoring by MCF Program Advisors.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Scholars may not engage in outside full-time employment; limited on-campus student work-study or research assistantships may be permitted.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: Scholars sign an ethical pledge to return to their home country or region to apply their education toward socio-economic transformation (give-back commitment).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Commitment to community service and active participation in the MCF Alumni Network.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Revocation of scholarship and expulsion from program for academic failure, financial misrepresentation, or disciplinary misconduct.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Degree change not permitted except under exceptional circumstances approved by the MCF Program Director.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Funding is strictly limited to 24 months (2 academic years plus necessary summer terms).
